newsitem.title: USA: CNN names Kaplan president of US news unit.
newsitem.headline: CNN names Kaplan president of US news unit.

text.p: Cable News Network said it named Richard Kaplan, a former news executive at Walt Disney Co's ABC News, as president of CNN/USA, the U.S. news network.
CNN also said it promoted Steve Korn, chief operating officer of parent CNN News Group, as vice chairman of the unit.
CNN News Group is a subsidiary of Time Warner Inc.
Kaplan was most recently executive producer of special projects for the ABC television and served as executive producer of "World News Tonight with Peter Jennings" and "Prime Time Live."
He will report to Tom Johnson, CNN News Group chairman.
Korn joined Turner Broadcasting System Inc, now part of Time Warner, in 1983 and served as general counsel before being named COO in 1996.
CNN also announced several other promotions: Lou Dobbs, executive vice president of CNN/FN, the financial news network, was promoted to president of the network.
Bob Furnad, executive vice president of Headline News, was named president of the network. Eason Jordan was promoted to president of CNN International and CNN En Espanol.
Jim Walton, who has headed CNN Sports since 1995, was promoted to president CNN/SI, the 24-hour sports news channel.
